description: Routing case — an email-drafting request routes to Gmail Agent, the last high-volume specialist with no routing coverage (#177). Real Gemini drives the routing decision. Gmail Agent registers as a handoff target even without Composio tools (orchestrator.py), so the terminal-agent assertion holds; the specialist replies with a connect prompt rather than calling a tool. must_not_route_to keeps the Buildium/Web/Browser/Document lanes explicitly forbidden so 'late rent payment' doesn't drift to the accounting-flavored Buildium Agent.

input.user_message: Draft an email to the tenant in unit 4B about their late rent payment
